caption: This image shows a Shaktiman SRT-1 Mini Series rotary tiller, a tractor-mounted implement used for soil cultivation. The view highlights the primary drive assembly, including the gearbox, PTO input shaft, and the chain-drive side housing. Technicians can use this to identify the main structural components, blade orientation, and the mounting points for the three-point hitch system.
